_comment: Describes the bundled Whisper tiny.en speech-to-text model files (voice input for Overwhelm Manager). Same provisioning pattern as overwhelm/manifest.json — owner fills sha256 + bytes after downloading. DO NOT leave encoderSource/decoderSource/tokenizerSource unset in useSpeechToText: the library defaults to fetching these from the network at runtime (source field below), which breaks the zero-network guarantee. Always pass local file:// sources from voiceModelProvisioner.ts.
name: voice-input-whisper-tiny-en
